استقصين (form X)
# اِسْتَقْصَيْنَ (istaqṣayna) /is.taq.sˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# اُسْتُقْصِينَ (ustuqṣīna) /us.tuq.sˤiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# اِسْتَقْصِينَ (istaqṣīna) /is.taq.sˤiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
